comment: The Density tooltip and the code disagree above three fifths of the knob's travel. The tooltip's DensityParamQuantity computes 28 + (value - 0.6) * 50, counting from 28 steps up to 48 (src/PPaTTTerning.cpp:20-22), while generateMapping computes 28 + (density - 0.2) * 60 and then clamps to 48, which is already past 48 at 0.6 (src/PPaTTTerning.cpp:207-210). So the tooltip reports a step count the sequence does not run. Above four fifths of the Density travel every few steps of the pattern are also shifted by two knobs (src/PPaTTTerning.cpp:253-258), which is not signposted anywhere on the panel. The panel prints CLK, RST, the digits 1 to 5 over the five knobs, MODE, DENSITY, CHAOS, CV OUT, TRIG, T2.DLY and CVD; the two lower output jacks carry no lettering of their own. Lettering is drawn in code at src/PPaTTTerning.cpp:472-551.
